paragraph: Granville’s composite system flashes a cautious 38 out of 100 reading this morning, driven by underlying internal weakness despite the absence of an immediate breadth divergence warning. Risk appetite deteriorated sharply with SPHB trailing SPLV by 1.64%, and economically sensitive transports lagged the broader market by 0.69%, though defensive rotation and high-yield credit spreads remained stable at 3.30%. This internal hesitation unfolds against a tranquil macro backdrop featuring a calm VIX at 18.79, a normal contango volatility term structure, and a stable dollar at $29.43, even as the 10-year real yield pushes higher to 2.66%. Ultimately, while calm volatility prevents outright panic, the weak Granville score and heavy underperformance in high-beta proxies dictate a defensive, sell-the-rip posture for today's session.
